reviews.text: I have had great experiences at this salon! Alex is amazing and always does a phenomenal job!! Cute, clean and unique environment, and everyone I’ve met there is super friendly. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

I’ve been getting my hair done by Kourtney Lynn since 2022 at Panther City Salon and highly recommend her. She’s amazing and always does exactly what I want with my hair. Super cute salon and very friendly atmosphere.
Kourtney is the best at highlights! I’ve been going to her for years and she always does an amazing job. The salon is very clean and relaxing - everyone is super friendly
